# Trackforce Appoints Security Veteran Scott Kaine as CEO to Accelerate Global Expansion and Innovation

**SAN DIEGO, Calif. – January 12, 2026** – Trackforce, a leader in physical security and operational intelligence, today announced the appointment of Scott Kaine as Chief Executive Officer. Kaine’s appointment marks the beginning of the company’s next phase of global growth as organizations increasingly seek modern, technology-driven solutions to secure their people and assets in complex environments.

The Board of Directors thanks outgoing CEO Byron McDuffie, who will remain with the company as a strategic advisor. During his tenure, Trackforce built a world-class technology foundation, establishing itself as an innovator in the physical security space. With this platform in place, Trackforce is positioned to capture accelerating demand for integrated security operations.

Scott Kaine is a recognized security and technology executive with a track record of scaling high-growth companies. He previously served as CEO of Cyveillance and Delta Risk and held senior leadership roles at Motorola Solutions. Kaine began his career as an Intelligence Officer in the U.S. Army.

“Trackforce is tackling the most critical challenges in the physical security space,” said Scott Kaine, CEO of Trackforce. “The demand for modern security technology is reaching a tipping point. I am excited to partner with our team and our customers to scale that impact worldwide”.

**About Trackforce** Trackforce is a leader in security operations management software, providing intelligent, data-driven solutions for physical security teams. Learn more at [www.trackforce.com](https://www.trackforce.com/).
